brand.headline: One workspace for how your team ships.
brand.tagline: Boards, time, documents and chat in one place — with the access control, audit trail and security a company needs.

security.title: Secure by design
security.body: Roles and permissions, two-factor sign-in and an audit log.

realtime.title: Live, not refreshed
realtime.body: Boards, comments and presence update as people work.

integrations.title: Plays well with others
integrations.body: GitHub, Google Calendar and email are built in.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your LecodeKanban workspace.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Start organising your team's work in minutes.
register.invitedSubtitle: Set your name and a password. Your address is already filled in from the invitation.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. It's valid for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick something strong you haven't used before.
reset.successBody: You've been signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.
reset.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.

verify.successBody: Thanks! Your email address is verified.

banner.unverified: Please confirm your email — we sent a link to {{email}}.

invite.bodyNoInviter: You've been invited to join “{{workspace}}” as {{role}}.

invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the sender for a new one.
invite.used: This invitation has already been used.
invite.newHint: You don't need a password from anyone — you choose your own on the next screen.
invite.hasAccountHint: This address already has an account. Sign in, or choose a new password if you have forgotten it.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
